intents.statement: A user should be able to create a record, read it back, and archive it when it is no longer wanted.

specifications.statement: Creating a record returns 201 with the created record's id, and a request missing a title is rejected with 400.
Reading a record id that does not exist returns 404, and reading one that exists returns 200 with that record.
Archiving a record removes it from the records list and leaves it readable by id, and archiving an already-archived record changes nothing.
